page.layout: One column of verse, set as a poem in lines of italic type, indented at each stanza break. The running title is printed at the top centre. No notes, no margins. A gathering signature stands at the lower right, below the last line.

p.i: Cælicolæ, tibi mille acies per inane paratis Curribus igniuomis circunstant curribus omnes Ardenti in nymbo: romphæísque micantibus ardent, Te circum mille Aligeri super ardua Jurae: Quales ille olim uidit stupefactus apertis Prospiciens oculis cani latera ardua montis Cingere, & innumeros lucere ardentibus armis.

Hæc tibi Hieropolis uigilat custodia pernox: Haud tibi mortales hac in statione locauit Excubias Pater omnipotens. Mactè ergo Geneua, Interea semper tu seruantissima iusti, Tu cæli monitus, tu Religionis amorem Obserua, & cultus nunquam dedisce receptos: Ac nunquam Deus hinc aberit, Deus optimus ille, Qui nullo Patrum merito gentísue, rebellem Abrâmi populum, sæuis tot cladibus olim Ereptum, ferreóque iugo, tristique profanæ Seruitio Ægypti, seruauit munere magno Rebus in extremis. Ille est, idem ille Geneua Qui te seruauit toties: totiesque cadenti, Quum nec libertas nec spes erat ulla salutis, Adfuit, & dextrâ placuit fulcire potenti.
Jam mihi Fortunam celebrent mendacia Graiûm, Fortunásque Jouésque, deûm tot nomina uana:

Fortunæ non illud opus; sed sancta potestas Illius, ingenti qui tot uasta æquora palma Continet, & cælum digitis premit omne duobus, Qui circumfuso librauit in aere Terram, Quique suas intra metas maria alta coercet Arduus, & Verbo retinet solidata potenti, Cælumque, & gelidi mediam liquidi aeris oram, Humida qui gelidæ Lunæ mouet incrementa, Qui Solem regit, & terris immittit adustis Opportunum imbrem, quum sicco languida cælo

page.notes: Printed lines are set in italic throughout; roman capitals only in the running title. The initial letter of the stanza 'Qpportunum' is read as 'Opportunum'. The 'Qui' stanza at lines 14 to 15 and the spelling 'gentísue' are copied as printed. The final line continues onto the next page. No page number is printed on this scan.
